title: instrument
description: Instrument registry entry. equity_scope tells whether the instrument counts for the exposure rules (max_issuer_exposure, min_issuer_exposure, exclusion, controversy_exclusion): true for equities and equity funds; false for bond funds, commodity funds and crypto assets, which contribute nothing to either exposure bound and are listed as out of scope on the rule result. is_fund with equity_scope true means the instrument is looked through using the holdings snapshot.

issuer_id.description: Company id; share classes of one company share it. Funds and crypto assets carry their own instrument_id here.

sector.description: Sector label exactly as given by sector_source, or null when no sourced label is held. A fund's own label (e.g. 'Broad market (U.S.)') is never applied to its constituents.

sector_source.description: source_id of the label; null iff sector is null.

registry.title: instrument_registry
registry.description: File shape of data/processed/instruments.json. Each key equals the entry's instrument_id.
